job.title: Tetris: Efficient Long-context LLM Serving with Chunkwise Dynamic Sequence Parallelism
job.selection_reason: ISCA 2026の査読論文。長文脈servingでsequence parallelismをrequest単位ではなくtoken chunk単位に動的割当し、disaggregated clusterでstage-specific parallelismとresource fragmentationを同時に扱う。最大4.35x TTFT改善、median TBT最大40.1%削減、request capacity最大45%増を報告する強いserving候補。
